name: aqar
description: Find properties to rent or buy in Saudi Arabia using Aqar listing search, property details and district lookup.

interface.longDescription:
Aqar is a real-estate search plugin for people looking to rent or buy property in Saudi Arabia. Users anywhere can search in Arabic or English by city, district, property type, price, area, bedrooms and furnishing. Browse public listings in photo cards, read individual property details, and look up Saudi districts. Supported properties include apartments, villas, floors, land, offices, stores, warehouses, rest houses and chalets.

Prices are in Saudi riyals (SAR); rental prices are per rental period, usually yearly. Every listing links to sa.aqar.fm. No Aqar account or precise user location is required. The plugin searches and reads listings; contacting advertisers, arranging viewings, booking and payment take place outside the plugin.
